mapper.select: select count(1) from fin_stock_ledger where del_flag = '0'
select count(distinct concat(dept_id, ':', product_id)) from fin_stock_ledger where del_flag = '0' and after_quantity < 0
select count(1) from fin_stock_position p where p.quantity != 0 and not exists ( select 1 from fin_stock_ledger l where l.dept_id = p.dept_id and l.product_id = p.product_id and l.del_flag = '0' )

select count(1) from fin_stock_position p where p.quantity != 0 and not exists ( select 1 from fin_stock_snapshot s where s.dept_id = p.dept_id and s.product_id = p.product_id and s.snapshot_date = date_sub(curdate(), interval 1 day) )

select count(1) from fin_stock_position p where exists ( select 1 from fin_stock_snapshot s where s.dept_id = p.dept_id and s.product_id = p.product_id and s.snapshot_date = curdate() and s.quantity != p.quantity )
